03 / Founding Sponsor

A place in the story.

For early supporters who want to help establish the project and be recognized for it.

  • Permanent Founding Sponsor recognition on the sponsors page.
  • Prominent website placement with your logo and link for 30 days.
  • A short description and early-access invitations to future releases, products, and services as available.

Permanent recognition · 30-day prominent placement.

Founding lasts. Placement has a term.

Your Founding Sponsor recognition is permanent. Prominent website placement runs for 30 consecutive days from the date your placement goes live.

After those 30 days, your founding credit remains on the sponsors page. You can renew prominent placement for another 30-day term, subject to availability. Renewal is optional.

A preview of what’s next.

Development and Founding Sponsors receive invitations to early previews as future releases, products, and services become available. Availability and timing depend on development progress.

Sponsors can share feedback and ideas. The CommonCopy team retains responsibility for the roadmap; sponsorship does not promise custom development or delivery dates.

Recognition on the website.

Sponsor placements are clearly labelled, with straightforward links to the people and businesses supporting the project. The desktop utility remains focused on your words, with no sponsor placements inside the app.

Sponsors do not receive access to your phrase library, clipboard, or usage data.
